title: SAL Facts Database Schema
description: Schema for sal-facts-latest.json and sal-facts-*.json databases produced by the Specification Authority Layer. NOTE: The 'qname' field in spec_facts contains FACT-FORMAT-NNN canonical IDs (e.g. 'FACT-FODS-001'), NOT namespace:element QNames. This is a historical naming quirk — the field acts as fact_id.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this database was generated.

generator.description: Name and version of the tool that generated this file.

formats_processed.description: Number of format entries in results.

spec_facts_total.description: Total spec_facts across all format results.

workbench_verified_fact_total.description: Number of facts that have been workbench-verified.

verification_status.description: Closed SAL verification-state vocabulary. Recognition by this schema does not itself make a fact promotion-eligible.

verified.meaning: Independently verified against pinned primary authority.

verified_with_note.meaning: Verified with a material qualification that consumers must evaluate.

workbench_verified.meaning: Verified inside the governed workbench; promotion requires retained workbench proof.

structural_derivation.meaning: Structurally derived claim; the derivation method is not independent verification.

pending_verification.meaning: Extraction completed but verification is pending.

not_found_in_normalized_text.meaning: Claim could not be located in the normalized authority text.

spec_facts.description: Extracted specification facts for this format.

fact_id.description: Canonical stable SAL identity. Required when qname carries an extended legacy alias.

qname.description: Compatibility fact alias (for example FACT-FODS-001 or legacy FACT-ZST-EX-0001), not an XML QName. Extended legacy aliases require a canonical fact_id.

claim.description: The specification claim or fact statement.

section.description: Section reference in the specification document.

fact_status.description: Current status of the fact in the pipeline.

readiness_categories.description: Explicit authority-readiness categories. New facts use these stable tags; legacy facts may still be classified by compatibility keyword rules.

authority_class.description: Authority classification. AI_DRAFT requires promotion before use in product decisions.
